subject: A content angle for BACÁN
body:
Hi,

I came across BACÁN and spent some time looking through the restaurant. What stood out most was the dramatic dining room inside the Lake Nona Wave Hotel — the architecture and art give the space a presence that most restaurant content does not capture at all.

From what I saw, BACÁN is already strong visually, but I think the content could lean more into the full dining experience — the room before service, the rhythm of the tasting progression, the plating details — so the viewer feels the occasion of dining there, not just the dishes.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for BACÁN would move through the tasting experience from arrival into the final course, using the room and service pace to make the content feel elevated and immersive.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for BACÁN.

Best,
Malachi
